title: style(instantsearch.css): install and set up Stylelint
body:
## Summary

This PR introduces Stylelint, a popular and full-fetaured CSS linter (think of it as ESLint for CSS). Now that `instantsearch.css` is in the monorepo and will be updated by feature teams, it will be useful to have it to verify that our CSS follows agreed-upon quality guidelines.

### Configuration

The `.stylelintrc.json` file describes the current configurations, plugons, and rules we use. I installed the recommended configurations from the Stylelint docs, and added some arbitrary ones that we already had experimented with in Unified InstantSearch (see [config](https://github.com/algolia/unified-instantsearch-ecommerce/blob/master/.stylelintrc.json)).

* `stylelint-no-unsupported-browser-features`: ensures we don't write CSS that's incompatible with our target browsers
* `stylelint-order`: enforces order of declarations within a ruleset, similar to [`eslint-plugin-import-order`](https://www.npmjs.com/package/eslint-plugin-import-order)

### Next steps

I purposefully didn't lint in the same PR because that's going to generate a lot of noise that will be hard to review. We should proceed methodically to keep the diffs readable and avoid regressions. We can do this later, as Stylelint isn't currently run in the CI.

To lint locally, run `yarn workspace instantsearch.css lint`.

We can also fine tune our rules later on as we reduce the existing violations and better understand where problems remain.
